title: What happened to the "Default (recommended)" model selection?
body:
Yesterday there was a most-excellent `/model` setting for MAX users which would use `opus` until 50% of quota was consumed, and automatically drop down to `sonnet` afterwards:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3bffd678-c911-4690-b3eb-291f0250aaca)

After upgrading to v1.0.7 today, `/model` gives me only one option:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0e55b719-2956-41e4-9e47-e3c257f89352)

- I'm on a MAX 20 plan.
- `/model opus` seems to still work, so perhaps it's just a change to the /model ui?

```
> /clear 
  ⎿  (no content)

> what model are you using?

● I'm using Claude Opus 4 (model ID:
  claude-opus-4-20250514).
```
author: mceachen
